A Week of New York Golf — Sedgewood, Union Vale and Bethpage Black
The sign by the first tee at Bethpage Black does not exaggerate. Forty-five holes in eight days: a private nine in the Hudson Valley with no tee sheet and a dog on the green, a links-style public gem in Dutchess County that gave up the best round of the week, and the Black on a cancellation, first out after the rain delay lifted.

[News]
Lions Municipal Golf Course
The Muny Is Getting
a Coore & Crenshaw
Renovation
Austin's oldest public course — and one of the most important in American golf — is about to get a world-class restoration. Here's what's coming.
The History
1924
Austin's first public course
In 1950, Lions became the first municipal course south of the Mason-Dixon line to desegregate — when two young Black caddies walked on and Mayor Taylor Glass said "Let them play." It stayed the only integrated muni in the South until 1953.
The Architects
Bill Coore &
Ben Crenshaw
The firm behind Pinehurst No. 2, Sand Hills, Sheep Ranch, and Cabot Cliffs. Crenshaw grew up playing Lions. Both are doing the renovation pro bono.
The Course Plan
Restore the Original
Pre-1974 Routing
141 acres returned to the layout that was intact from the course's golden era. The 1974 redesign altered the routing — Coore & Crenshaw will bring it back to what Crenshaw himself grew up playing.
Beyond Golf
New Clubhouse.
Restaurant. Trails.
Community Space.
New clubhouse & pro shop
Restaurant & event spaces
Expanded driving range
Trails to Town Lake
Farmers market & music
The Teaching Center
Honoring the
Integration of 1950
The historic clubhouse becomes a teaching center, golf museum, and civil rights education space. The very room where the call to Mayor Glass was placed will tell the story of what happened here.
Where Things Stand
2027
Current preservation deadline
The Muny Conservancy is working with the City and UT to secure the land permanently. The Imagine Muny gala has raised over $1M annually. The preservation district was extended to May 2027.
Support the Muny
themuny
conservancy.com
70,000 rounds a year. 100 years of history. The first integrated muni in the South. A Coore & Crenshaw restoration — for free. This is the most important story in Austin golf right now.
Lions Muny Is Getting a World-Class Renovation. Here's What's Coming.
Austin's oldest public course — open since 1924, desegregated since 1950 — is getting a full Coore & Crenshaw restoration. New clubhouse. Teaching center. Trails to Town Lake. And the architects are doing it for free.

Augusta National Golf Club
Masters 2027
Ticket Application
Is Open Now
June 1 – 20 at masters.com. You have twenty days and roughly a 1-in-200 shot. Apply anyway.
The Window
June 1 – June 20
Applications opened today. You have exactly twenty days to submit at masters.com. Log in or create an account, pick your days, pick your ticket count (1–4), and hope for the best.
How the Lottery Works
1Go to masters.com. Create an account or log into an existing one.
2Select the days you want to attend. You can apply for every day — practice and tournament.
3Choose 1–4 tickets per day. One entry per person. No gaming the system.
4After June 20, Augusta runs a random lottery. Winners notified by email. Everyone else gets a polite no.
Your Odds
0.55%
Chance of getting tournament tickets
Roughly 1 in 200. An estimated two million people apply each year. You will almost certainly not win. You should still apply.
2027 Ticket Prices
Face Value
Monday Practice$125
Tuesday Practice$125
Wednesday (Par 3 Contest)$150
Thursday – Sunday$160 / day
Mark Your Calendar
April 5 – 11, 2027
Mon–Wed, April 5–7Practice
Wednesday, April 7Par 3 Contest
Thu–Sun, April 8–11Tournament
The Fine Print
What You Should Know
•You can apply for every day but can only win one day.
•Tournament tickets drawn first. Losers re-entered for practice rounds.
•Resale is strictly prohibited. Augusta will revoke your badge at the gate.
•Series badge holders and Augusta employees are ineligible for tournament rounds.

Muni Kids Turns 11. The Muni Never Left.
Brothers Maxton and Drew Reinland started Muni Kids in Portland in 2015 because nobody was making golf gear for the people who actually learned the game on public courses. Eleven years later they've built a universe — headcovers, apparel, art, a podcast, urban golf meetups, a children's book called 'Golforia,' and a brick-and-mortar shop inside Portland's Memory Den. Before the indie golf scene had a name, Muni Kids was already screen-printing it.

Arthur Hills carved Wolfdancer through Lost Pines like he had a grudge against flat land. You do not need to be a Hyatt guest to play, which makes this the most accessible great course in the Austin orbit. Thirty minutes east and a world away from your Tuesday nine at the muni.

The Firecracker Open — 81 Years at the Muny
Lions Municipal opened in 1924 as Austin's first public course — nine holes cut through the oaks on Enfield Road by the Lions Club. In 1950, it quietly became the first desegregated public course south of the Mason-Dixon line. Since 1945, the Firecracker Open has drawn the best amateur players in Texas every Fourth of July weekend. Crenshaw, Kite, and Uresti all won here before turning pro. 54 holes, no cut, and a field that mixes college stars with 60-year-old regulars who've played the course a thousand times.

8 Best Practice Facilities Around Austin
The best public practice facility in Austin, full stop. Named after the man who wrote the Little Red Book. All-grass range — no mats, no rubber tees — plus two putting greens, a practice bunker, a 3-hole short course, and a PGA Tour-designed 9-hole layout. The range faces east, so afternoon sessions dodge the sun. Buckets run $8–$14. City-owned, open to everyone, and perpetually underrated.

Aimé Leon Dore SS26 Golf: Croc-Embossed FootJoys and a Sweater Your Grandfather Would Approve Of
ALD's third annual golf capsule dropped April 23 and it's the most complete yet. The headliner is the ALD × FootJoy Premiere Series Marquis in croc-embossed leather — $375, two colorways, waterproof, with a custom co-branded insole that goes harder than it needs to. Blackwatch plaid runs through a lightweight Tips windbreaker ($495) and a Cordura pullover ($295). The Clubhouse Sweater ($395) is 100% merino with an intarsia-knit golfer on the chest — the kind of piece that makes you look like you belong at a club even if you don't have a membership. Leather-and-Cordura putter cover, performance socks, a flask, and a cigar lighter round out the accessories. Three years in, Teddy Santis keeps treating golf like it's always been part of the culture.

[News]
The Mackenzie Club: A 33,000-Sq-Ft Private Indoor Golf Club Is Coming to West Lake Hills
Dave Rogenmoser spent a decade building online startups. Now he's building a three-story, 33,000-square-foot private golf and social club in West Lake Hills — and he named it after Alister MacKenzie, because of course he did. Eight Trackman simulator bays, a PuttView putting lab, outdoor short-game greens with Hill Country views, a chef-driven restaurant, wellness studio with sauna and cold plunge, and a pro shop. Michael Hsu is doing the architecture. Membership is application-based with a vetting process — "culture matters more than anything we're building, but we're not exclusive for the sake of being exclusive." Opening late 2026. Waitlist at mackenzieclub.com.

8 Bucket Hats Worth the Brim
The bucket hat is having its quiet moment on the course — no logos screaming from the crown, no performance fabric monologues on the hang tag. Just a wide brim, some shade, and the vague suggestion that you know what you're doing out there. Manors' Greenskeeper is recycled fabric with a wide brim that matches their jacket. Malbon covers the range from a clean $58 script logo to the reversible Velasco at $88. Students Golf went full boonie with a screen-printed marble camo that shouldn't work but does. And Birds of Condor — the Australian brand that treats golf hats like an art form — brings the Swing Kings reversible, a corduroy Rage, and the Fore Tiger. Four brands, eight hats, zero visors.

Agronomy Workshop — A Golf Shirt with a Hidden Tee Slot and Nothing to Prove
Rob Junge designed exactly one shirt, put a hidden tee holder in the chest pocket, and called it a golf brand. The mock neck heavyweight work shirt — 17.5 oz cotton, made in LA — is the kind of garment that makes you wonder why anyone ever thought polyester was the answer to anything. The hats come with a pencil holder and an actual pencil, because this is the rare brand that remembers you need to write things down on a golf course. Twelve SKUs total, three categories, zero hype — a catalog so small it fits on a scorecard, which is probably the point.

Late Nine — Stockholm, Relaxed Fits, and the Quiet Part of Golf
Founded in Stockholm in 2024, Late Nine makes golf clothes for people who think most golf clothes try too hard. Ribbed knits, pleated trousers, windbreakers — all cut relaxed, all made in small European factories that care about hand feel more than moisture-wicking stats. The references are late-'90s and early-2000s, back when golf showed up in film and nobody had to explain why it was cool. They use deadstock materials when they can, keep production runs limited, and price accordingly — polos from $252, outerwear north of $500. Not cheap, but you're paying for fabric choices made by people who clearly spend more time touching swatches than reading trend reports.

Jun 18–21 Tournament
Spanish Oaks GC · Bee Cave
117th Texas Amateur
The state's premier amateur championship comes to Austin. 72 holes of stroke play, 144-player field cut to 54 after 36. Winner gets an exemption into the U.S. Amateur at Philadelphia CC. Qualifying rounds running now through May.
txga.org ↗
Jul 3–5 Tournament
Lions Municipal Golf Course · Austin
Firecracker Open
The most important amateur tournament in Central Texas. Three days at the Muny over the Fourth of July weekend. Defending champ Charles Neel White. Non-exempt players qualify June 20 and June 23. Entry is $285.
austintexas.gov ↗
Jul 31 – Aug 2 Tournament
Various Courses · Austin
Austin City Championship
The city title. Qualifiers at Morris Williams (Jul 25) and Jimmy Clay (Jul 27), championship rounds across Austin courses. Defending men's champion Jack Cersosimo.
austinamateurgolf.com ↗

Omni Barton Creek · Fazio Canyons
Good Good Championship (PGA Tour)
The PGA Tour returns to Austin for the first time since 2023. 120-player field, 500 FedExCup points, broadcast on Golf Channel and ESPN+. Hosted by Good Good Golf at the newly renovated Fazio Canyons Course. Tickets on sale now.
